name: Castle Utility Variant
prompt: Create a grounded castle-utility variant of a potion bottle family for a warm interior fantasy RPG slice. Show the prop alone, centered, with a clean background and coherent lighting. Focus on the practical version of the object rather than an ornate hero prop. Style constraints: readable silhouette, family resemblance, game-friendly detail, reusable variants. Materials: glass, cork, iron, worn labels. Mood: grounded, warm, alchemical, practical. Intended use: Reusable tincture, draught, and elixir bottle family for alchemy ingredients, crafted potions, and loot variants.
